hook_text: Every piece of junk in this scrapyard was chosen for a reason. Can you work out why?
clip_script: A scrapyard in Welkom. A dented pot: metal, because it carries heat and will not melt on the stove. A coil of copper wire: drawn thin and great at carrying electricity. A corrugated roof sheet: steel, pressed into waves for stiffness and coated in zinc against rust. A crushed car: strong steel pressed into shape. A gold ring: shiny and never rusts. Now it all gets melted down and made into something new.
visual_style: Whiteboard scrap pile where each object lights up with a property label, then everything slides into a furnace.
mood: Curious detective work with a recycling twist.
pacing: Five objects, five properties, then one big recycling finish.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list ten metal things at your school and why they are metal.
